notes: Reviewed strict white Grand Cru specifications for the remaining Montrachet-family AOCs plus Charlemagne. Conditional fermentable-sugar relief to 4 g/L is conservatively fail-closed at the unconditional 3 g/L ceiling until its acidity condition is modeled. Transitional mixed-planting exceptions are not promoted into ordinary cellar blend authorization.
